description:
INCONSISTENCY (surfaced by the ground-literal-value fold investigation): the SAME source keyword `nil` types two different ways depending on position.

- As an expression literal: Literal::Nil -> world.types.nil() = Descr::atom_lit("nil") -- the ATOM nil (jobs/semantic.rs:2114; types/descr.rs:76-78).
- As a pattern / dispatch const: DispatchConst::Nil -> world.types.empty_list() = ListSig::empty() -- the EMPTY LIST (jobs/semantic.rs:2131).

Same syntax, same unit payload, different Ty depending on expression- vs pattern-position lowering. This is a latent correctness/consistency question independent of the fold: the GroundValue fold shares the VALUE representation (GroundValue::Nil) but the per-consumer TYPING functions stay separate and continue to disagree until this is resolved.

Decide the intended meaning of `nil` in each position and align. Grep fixtures for programs relying on either behavior before changing. Parser context: quoted_function.rs:324 (`"nil" => Expr::Nil`); pattern path dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:319.
title: nil types as atom in expression position but as empty-list in pattern position (same syntax, divergent Ty)
